children: The ZEW economic expectations index rose to 35.6 from 28.1 in September, coming in ahead of expectations for a more modest increase to 28.8.
The current conditions index printed at -33.2 in November, versus -35.9 a month earlier.

ZEW President Achim Wambach said: "Expectations improve in November. The German economy remains on its recovery track, albeit moving at a slow rate. Increasing manufacturing orders and falling oil prices are likely to underpin the upturn.
"The mainstay of the recovery has been government expenditure so far, but this leads to rising concerns about the sustainability of public debt."
